Root Canals. Protecting your mouth from infection and saving teeth from extraction. ​ Root canal therapy (or endodontics) involves removing the infected pulp from the innermost part of the tooth. This prevents the infection from spreading and can help save a tooth that may otherwise have to be extracted. Signs of infection: Pain when biting Tenderness or Sensitivity Swelling or an abscess in the gum Fever Discolouration or increased mobility of the tooth Book an Appointment Why is root canal treatment necessary? If the hard external structure of the tooth is breached, bacteria can easily reach the soft tissues inside – the pulp.
